name: Skewer's mark is applied and consumed natively (#2083)
contract: Spell 800095 is a pure marker debuff with no amount, period or trigger; both ends of its life are stock DBC mechanics with no script. Skewer (800093) triggers it on a cone of enemies through effect 1, giving each a single stack for 10000 ms, and Skewer (Pull) [GRIP] (800148) is gated on TargetAuraSpell 800095 and removes it again through its REMOVE_AURA effect. The issue is filed under Tinker, but 800095 is SpellFamilyName 27, which this fork maps to CLASS_RANGER, so the fixture is a Ranger; both spells require an equipped polearm and cost focus. The duration band allows the poll delay between the cast and the measurement. Skewer is DmgClass 2 (SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_MELEE), so Unit::MeleeSpellHitResult rolls a 5% miss and a 5% dodge separately for each golem in the cone (the golems face away from the Ranger, so parry and block do not apply), and a missed or dodged golem never receives the Effect 1 trigger; an accelerated run recorded the nearer golem unmarked for the whole 3000 ms window with no cast failure. The Ranger therefore carries melee_hit_rating and expertise_rating 10000, which remove only those avoidance rolls. The pull is DmgClass 0 with SPELL_ATTR7_NO_ATTACK_MISS and needs no rating.

steps.label: The nearer enemy in the cone is marked
The farther enemy in the cone is marked as well
The mark is a single stack
The mark runs the full 10 second duration
The pull consumes the mark it was gated on
The untargeted enemy keeps its own mark
